geo-platform-optimizer 1.0.0

- Initial release of the geo-platform-optimizer skill.
- Provides platform-specific AI search optimization checklists and scoring rubrics for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Bing Copilot.
- Includes detailed criteria and action items tailored to each AI search engine’s unique ranking and citation logic.
- Guides users through site audit, per-platform scoring (0–100), and generation of GEO-PLATFORM-OPTIMIZATION.md.
- Emphasizes entity optimization, content structure, and authoritative sourcing for AI visibility.
